author: Mona x Supercars
acquisition: User downloaded from the official Sketchfab download entry and placed the ZIP in original/ after the login handoff.
modifications: PBR material adaptation; original diffuse color retained
Packed textures and self-contained GLB; no component animation
I2: semantic four-window roots from original source glass; local translation into doors, no glass scaling or opacity animation; adjacent static glazing retained

I4: source door shells, inner trim, mirrors and split return strips on calibrated hinges; original deck and attached lamp/logo surfaces partitioned into trunk lid; recessed open cavity and inner skin added; all original glazing retained.

I6: split the actual original Mesh24 twin wiper assemblies; calibrated windshield-normal pivots and eight surface-conforming morph corrections; source passenger assembly physically shortened to eliminate driver-pivot crossings; runtime scale remains one; front LED depth refined beneath original lenses; isolated graphite display material improves wiper visibility.

Trunk correction: original complete native panel islands restored from the I3 source, including original positions, UVs and per-corner normals; no arbitrary bisects; rounded original deck/fascia and factory lamp split move as whole parts; exterior hull caps and edge strips removed; inner cover and lining inset behind original outer skin.

I5: eight original Mesh61 projector surfaces, original Mesh62/73 front diffusers and Mesh19/20 inner rear modules use independent cloned emission materials; outer contour now has an independent constant-red running material; signals emit yellow only while lit and restore original colours in off half-cycles and when disabled; 14 former tube/rod proxies removed; source positions/UV/normals preserved; physical cabin LEDs remain.

Cabin lighting: 25 surface-fitted ribbon diffusers on native upper trim, door inlays, handles, speaker outlines, dashboard crown, central tunnel and rear console. 16 short-range lights include front/rear footwell and door-pocket wash, eight attached to the four door hinges. All 140 baseline nodes preserved; additive design on the existing enhanced Blender project.

Dome/tail: 714 native outermost rear-ring triangles use an independent constant-red running-lamp material, all geometry/UV/normals preserved; two compact ceiling fixtures follow measured front console/rear roof surface normals; independent downward spotlights and manual/rule/ASR-TTS controls.

Frunk: native Paint7 bonnet islands and Mesh65 badge on rear-edge hinge; original 82-vertex seam, UVs and normals preserved with zero bisects; fitted recessed inner skin, storage tub, flange and hinge hardware added; wide diffuse cabin lights use 143-degree soft cones and low-power local fill.

Enclosure repair: 0.7.2 rebuilds only three helper liners with formed thickness, wheel clearance, shorter cargo space and a continuous native-surface-fitted lid liner with edge returns; adds an opaque cabin floor backing. Other 150 baseline nodes remain exact. Four downward shadowed footwell lights replace unoccluded point lights; source display atlas has selective runtime backlighting.
